raw_posts.name: MCP Connectors by Databox
raw_posts.tagline: Give your AI Analyst context to explain performance and act
raw_posts.description: Connect your AI Analyst to the tools your business runs on. It pulls context from your CRM or support desk, so every answer reflects what's happening in your business, and it can act on what it finds. Choose from 10+ connectors or add any MCP server.

raw_posts.name: SaleSmartly
raw_posts.tagline: Turn conversations across every channel into customers
raw_posts.description: SaleSmartly brings customer conversations from WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, TikTok, Telegram, LINE, WeChat and more into one workspace. Manage leads with a built-in CRM, let AI agents answer questions and qualify customers 24/7, translate conversations in real time, and automate follow-ups—all while your team keeps the context needed to turn more conversations into customers.

raw_posts.name: Statable Analytics
raw_posts.tagline: Web analytics built for you and your AI agents
raw_posts.description: Statable is web analytics built for humans and AI agents. Use the simple dashboard yourself, or connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex, and other agents through MCP to read reports, analyze traffic, and configure tracking, goals, and funnels. No cookies, no analytics consent banner in most cases, and your data stays hosted in the EU.

raw_posts.name: Vitals 
raw_posts.tagline: A Mac activity monitor that thinks in apps, not processes
raw_posts.description: Activity Monitor lists a thousand processes, a hundred of them called Google Chrome Helper. Vitals adds every helper to the app that launched it, so you see 60 apps instead of 1,000 processes, each with one figure for memory, CPU, energy, disk and network. It keeps 30 days of history, alerts you when an app misbehaves, finds forgotten dev servers, and shows temperatures, fans and battery. Every readout can sit in your menu bar, arranged your way. Pay once. No subscription, no account.

raw_posts.name: VibeDefend by CybeDefend
raw_posts.tagline: The one command line to secure your Cursor and Claude Code
raw_posts.description: VibeDefend installs on your AI coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, Codex and more) with one command. From then on the agent writes with your business rules, mined from your repo, and your security rules in its context. It scans each diff while the file is still open, and a guard refuses rm -rf, sudo or a read of your secrets before it runs. Scanners check code after the commit, this runs before the line is written. Free plan, no card.

raw_posts.name: Okara
raw_posts.description: Okara is an AI CMO. Enter your website and it studies your product, competitors and brand voice, then runs 10+ agents for SEO, AI search, Reddit, X, LinkedIn, creators and UGC video. You approve every draft and it publishes. Used by 100,000+ businesses.

raw_posts.name: GenCode
raw_posts.tagline: A coding agent inside the Genspark Super App
raw_posts.description: GenCode is Genspark’s coding agent with Chat and Terminal UIs. It supports models from Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, and more, and works directly on code in a directory you choose.

raw_posts.name: Shotcandy
raw_posts.description: Paste a screenshot. Get something lovely. Shotcandy is a free screenshot beautifier that turns plain screenshots into beautiful, share-ready images and videos in seconds, right in your browser.

Copilot connects with your work content and the apps you already use, bringing together the latest AI models to help you create finished work, not just answers.
